monotoneOrderArgument: A continuously alive immutable key remaining above the cursor is eligible for every subsequent read. A nonterminal read advances to its last returned key, so advancing past that key must return it first. At a terminal read every remaining eligible key is returned. Thus continuous initial keys are covered under this fixed scope and single-transition, no-resurrection model. Keys inserted below a prior cursor and final freshness have separate cuts.
